subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a deep gnome guide who defends his navigational choices as the party emerges from a detour in the Underdark.
source_quote: Jimjar, the deep gnome guide, found himself defending his navigational choices as the party emerged from yet another unexpected detour through the Underdark.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar proposes a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would mark the party's journey.
source_quote: Jimjar, never one to pass up an opportunity, proposed a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would indeed mark their journey.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin predicts that the party's situation will end in tears, meaning some unfortunate event will befall them before reaching safety.
source_quote: Thorin, ever the skeptic, predicted that this situation would end in tears, meaning some unfortunate event would befall them before they reached safety.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin accepts Jimjar's wager after the terms are carefully defined.
source_quote: After carefully defining the terms, Thorin accepted the bet.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz confirms that an earthquake has caused an underground reservoir to crack open, flooding the cave system.
source_quote: Daz investigated further and confirmed the dire situation: an earthquake had caused an underground reservoir to crack open, and water was pouring into the cave system.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir strikes a gray ooze with powerful blows from his bare fists and dispatches it quickly.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward without hesitation, striking the creature with a series of powerful blows from his bare fists. The ooze stood no chance against the monk's relentless assault and was quickly dispatched.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a massive gelatinous cube who blocks a narrow passage with his ten-foot-by-ten-foot body.
source_quote: Glabbagool—a massive gelatinous cube they had just befriended—inadvertently blocked the narrow passage with his ten-foot-by-ten-foot body.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool was once an ordinary gelatinous cube that mindlessly cleaned floors and consumed debris.
source_quote: Glabbagool explained that he had once been an ordinary cube, mindlessly cleaning floors and consuming debris,

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool recently gained the ability to think and speak and is confused by his newfound sentience.
source_quote: but had recently gained the ability to think and speak. He was confused by his newfound sentience but eager to understand the world around him.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool agrees to join the party after Thorin invites him.
source_quote: Thorin, seeing an opportunity for both companionship and utility, invited Glabbagool to join their adventure. The cube agreed enthusiastically,

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool promises to eat anything the party drops on the floor.
source_quote: promising to eat anything they dropped on the floor

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expresses gratitude when Thorin offers him a lucky foot as a welcoming gift.
source_quote: expressing gratitude when Thorin offered him a lucky foot as a welcoming gift.

subject: gray ooze
fact: A gray ooze emerges from the rising waters in the square-shaped chamber.
source_quote: a gray ooze emerged from the rising waters, its amorphous form undulating menacingly.

subject: gray ooze
fact: Daz finishes off one of the gray oozes with a devastating spell.
source_quote: Daz finished off one of the gray oozes with a devastating spell,

subject: black pudding
fact: A black pudding emerges from the depths after Thorin falls into a hidden pit trap.
source_quote: Thorin fell victim to a hidden pit trap, barely managing to grab the edge and pull himself out before a black pudding emerged from the depths.

subject: gray ooze
fact: A gray ooze materializes when Glabbagool touches one of the formless sculptures in the chamber with the stone fountain.
source_quote: When Glabbagool touched one of the formless sculptures, it immediately materialized into a gray ooze.

subject: gray ooze
fact: Zalthir dispatches each gray ooze that emerges from the seven niches in the chamber with the stone fountain.
source_quote: The party decided to activate the remaining statues one by one to avoid being overwhelmed, and Zalthir made quick work of each ooze that emerged.

subject: square-shaped chamber
fact: The square-shaped chamber contains rising water and a gray ooze emerging from it.
source_quote: The party pressed forward through a square-shaped chamber, hoping it would lead to an exit rather than deeper into the flooded labyrinth. As Thorin led the charge, a gray ooze emerged from the rising waters, its amorphous form undulating menacingly.

subject: intersection chamber
fact: The intersection chamber contains pools of water suggesting dangers lurking beneath the surface.
source_quote: At an intersection, they encountered another chamber where pools of water suggested more dangers lurking beneath the surface.

subject: chamber with drow remains
fact: The chamber contains the hovering remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins.
source_quote: In a chamber containing the hovering remains of a drow, along with a dark metal mace and scattered coins, they had encountered the sentient gelatinous cube.

subject: chamber with stone fountain
fact: The chamber with the stone fountain contains a broken statue atop a pedestal and seven niches carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.
source_quote: a stone fountain filled with shallow, brackish water. A broken statue rested atop a pedestal in the center, and seven niches were carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.

subject: main chamber
fact: The main chamber has an eastern passageway where the sound of pouring water grows louder.
source_quote: Returning to the main chamber, the party proceeded down an eastern passageway where the sound of pouring water grew louder.

subject: cavern
fact: The party emerges into a large cavern after swimming upward through the newly revealed underground river.
source_quote: They successfully reached the surface, emerging into a large cavern where they could resume their journey.

subject: dark metal mace
fact: A dark metal mace is found in the chamber with the hovering remains of a drow.
source_quote: In a chamber containing the hovering remains of a drow, along with a dark metal mace and scattered coins, they had encountered the sentient gelatinous cube.

subject: drow dagger
fact: A drow dagger is discovered in a hidden cache of treasure in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: Glabbagool ... discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: vial of oil of slipperiness
fact: A vial of oil of slipperiness is discovered in a hidden cache of treasure in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: Glabbagool ... discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: lucky foot
fact: Thorin offers Glabbagool a lucky foot as a welcoming gift.
source_quote: expressing gratitude when Thorin offered him a lucky foot as a welcoming gift.

subject: one hundred twelve silver pieces
fact: One hundred twelve silver pieces are found in a hidden cache of treasure in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: Glabbagool ... discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: three gold pieces
fact: Three gold pieces are found in a hidden cache of treasure in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: Glabbagool ... discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: Jimjar's wager
fact: Jimjar and Thorin make a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would mark their journey.
source_quote: Jimjar, never one to pass up an opportunity, proposed a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would indeed mark their journey. After carefully defining the terms, Thorin accepted the bet.

subject: flood begins
fact: An earthquake causes an underground reservoir to crack open, flooding the cave system.
source_quote: Daz investigated further and confirmed the dire situation: an earthquake had caused an underground reservoir to crack open, and water was pouring into the cave system.

subject: gray ooze dispatched
fact: Zalthir dispatches the gray ooze in the square-shaped chamber with bare-fisted blows.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward without hesitation, striking the creature with a series of powerful blows from his bare fists. The ooze stood no chance against the monk's relentless assault and was quickly dispatched.

subject: Glabbagool joins party
fact: Glabbagool agrees to join the party after Thorin invites him.
source_quote: Thorin, seeing an opportunity for both companionship and utility, invited Glabbagool to join their adventure. The cube agreed enthusiastically,

subject: Thorin falls into pit trap
fact: Thorin falls into a hidden pit trap and barely grabs the edge before a black pudding emerges.
source_quote: Thorin fell victim to a hidden pit trap, barely managing to grab the edge and pull himself out before a black pudding emerged from the depths.

subject: black pudding defeated
fact: The party successfully kites and defeats the black pudding by attacking it from range.
source_quote: They successfully kited the creature, attacking it from range until it was defeated.

subject: gray ooze materializes from sculpture
fact: A gray ooze materializes when Glabbagool touches one of the formless sculptures.
source_quote: When Glabbagool touched one of the formless sculptures, it immediately materialized into a gray ooze.

subject: seven gray oozes dispatched
fact: Zalthir dispatches each gray ooze that emerges from the seven niches in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: The party decided to activate the remaining statues one by one to avoid being overwhelmed, and Zalthir made quick work of each ooze that emerged.

subject: treasure discovered
fact: Glabbagool discovers a hidden cache of treasure in the stone fountain: 112 silver, 3 gold, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.
source_quote: Glabbagool ... discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: underground river breaks through
fact: Thorin breaks through a wall, revealing a diverted underground river that provides a path to safety.
source_quote: Thorin used his considerable strength to break through the wall, causing more of the ceiling to collapse and doubling the water flow. However, this also revealed a diverted underground river that provided a path to safety.

subject: party swims upward
fact: The party swims upward for about thirty feet through the newly revealed underground river passage.
source_quote: As the water level rose to the ceiling, the party swam upward for about thirty feet through the newly revealed passage.

subject: party emerges to surface
fact: The party emerges into a large cavern after swimming upward through the underground river.
source_quote: They successfully reached the surface, emerging into a large cavern where they could resume their journey.

subject: wager declared draw
fact: Jimjar declares the wager a draw due to Glabbagool joining the party, and Thorin agrees.
source_quote: Jimjar declared that the adventure had not ended in tears after all, and he offered to call the bet a draw due to the charming and helpful Glabbagool joining their ranks. Thorin agreed,

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is the party's intended destination after navigating the Underdark.
source_quote: Jimjar ... insisted that the shifting passages were to be expected and that finding an exit through their current location was remarkably convenient—perhaps even a shortcut to their destination of Blingdenstone.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth, another dwarf in the party, recognizes the flooding phenomenon as an underground river breaking through the stone.
source_quote: Eldeth, another dwarf in the party, recognized the phenomenon as an underground river breaking through the stone.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth shares stories of people who escaped similar flooding situations by breaking through rock.
source_quote: She shared stories of people who had successfully escaped similar situations by breaking through the rock,

subject: wait a few days
fact: The party acknowledges they will need to wait a few days for Glabbagool to digest and pass the treasure items.
source_quote: The party acknowledged that they would need to wait a few days for Glabbagool to digest and pass the items, but they were grateful for the find nonetheless.

subject: drow
fact: Drow are referenced as having been present in the chamber with hovering remains, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins.
source_quote: In a chamber containing the hovering remains of a drow, along with a dark metal mace and scattered coins, they had encountered the sentient gelatinous cube.

subject: gelatinous cube
fact: Glabbagool is a sentient gelatinous cube who joins the party.
source_quote: Glabbagool—a massive gelatinous cube they had just befriended—inadvertently blocked the narrow passage with his ten-foot-by-ten-foot body.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth warns that breaking through rock to escape flooding may cause water to flood even faster.
source_quote: but she also warned of the risk of causing the water to flood even faster.

subject: party creates air pockets
fact: The party decides to use magic to create temporary air pockets to move through flooded passages safely.
source_quote: One member proposed using a spell to manipulate the water, creating temporary bubbles of air that would allow them to move through the flooded passages safely. They decided to proceed with this plan, creating a progression of air pockets and advancing five feet at a time.

subject: black pudding
fact: The black pudding is a hazard that emerges from a pit trap and is later defeated by the party.
source_quote: Thorin fell victim to a hidden pit trap, barely managing to grab the edge and pull himself out before a black pudding emerged from the depths.

subject: stone fountain
fact: The stone fountain is filled with shallow, brackish water and is located in a chamber with a broken statue and seven niches.
source_quote: a stone fountain filled with shallow, brackish water. A broken statue rested atop a pedestal in the center, and seven niches were carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.

subject: stone fountain chamber
fact: The stone fountain chamber has seven niches carved into its walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.
source_quote: a stone fountain filled with shallow, brackish water. A broken statue rested atop a pedestal in the center, and seven niches were carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.

subject: formless sculptures
fact: Seven formless sculptures are placed in niches in the stone fountain chamber.
source_quote: seven niches were carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures.

subject: Glabbagool cleans ooze remnants
fact: Glabbagool meticulously cleans up the remnants of the gray oozes, leaving the floor spotless.
source_quote: Glabbagool meticulously cleaned up the remnants, leaving the floor spotless.

subject: Glabbagool investigates fountain
fact: Glabbagool investigates the stone fountain and discovers a hidden cache of treasure.
source_quote: He then investigated the fountain itself and discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.

subject: Glabbagool immune to drowning
fact: Glabbagool confirms he does not need to breathe and is immune to drowning.
source_quote: Glabbagool confirmed that he did not need to breathe, making him immune to the drowning threat,

subject: Glabbagool agrees to resurrection
fact: Glabbagool agrees to allow the party to attempt resurrection on any fallen members before consuming them.
source_quote: and he agreed to allow the party to attempt resurrection on any fallen members before consuming them.
